description: List the attachments in your rooms (or one room), newest first, with the message they came in, their sender and, for files already downloaded, their local path. Use huddo_download with the msgid to save one.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

from.description: Only files from this member (slug or display name)

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

type.description: A MIME type part or extension, e.g. image, pdf, png

name: huddo_files
